reason: Spec E-20260928-13 tests whether graph-predicate preconditions on five PDLC Action types catch seeded violations better than retrieval alone, and whether Jev or an open-weight 4B checker adds recall on prose preconditions; it cannot re-grade B25 (firm) but decides whether the product can enforce it at action time, and it adds a guard the card lacked (predicates frozen before cases are built, violations tagged expressible or prose-only) so the rule arm cannot be circular. It takes the priority 3 reserved slot now because it decides whether the ADR-0011 amendment gains Action types at all.
